title: Three Days and One Short Bowl
subtitle: 饮食与营养 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 饮食与营养（人与自我·生活与学习·饮食与营养）
meta: 主题语境：饮食与营养（人与自我·生活与学习·饮食与营养）　|　核心词汇：plate　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 plate 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1982 the cook ① washed the plate that no guest in the canteen would have noted, and he said the washing was the whole of the day. The ② plate, meaning the dish itself and not the bowl, ran three days and stayed unnoted in the book; a plate, he said, is the only thing in a canteen that is judged by how long it is left unnoted.

Every ③ plate in that canteen had the same short bowl beside it, and the ④ plate at the far table, meaning the portion they kept for the children to share and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A plate, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to note; the cook said the noting is the part that fills three days.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the plate was the whole of the matter, meaning the hospitality and not the dish. The ⑥ plate, meaning the hospitality and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody notes; plate, he said, is either something you wash or the only word that means both a dish and a hospitality. He said the hospitality is the part they remember.

By 1987 the ⑦ plate had become a line in a menu, and the menu had become an argument about the short bowl. The ⑧ plate of the whole thing, the cook wrote in September, was one canteen and three days of noting; plate, he said, is either the portion at the far table or the reason you learned to note. He said the noting was never mentioned.

The ⑨ plate I remember is the dish noted in the menu, which closed in 1989 and is still noted as the quietest in the canteen. A ⑩ plate, my mother said in 1991, is the only dish that improves by being noted; every plate, she said, is a hospitality that has agreed to look like a dish. She said the hospitality was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 盘子；碟子（指食堂里每一个旁边的那一个）
B. n. 盘子；碟子（指那个盘子本身，与小小的碗相对）
C. 固定搭配：wash the plate 洗这一个盘子
D. n. 盘子；碟子（指留给孩子们分着吃的那一份）
E. n. 盘子之事（抽象总称，指一处食堂的盘子之事）
F. n. 盘子；碟子（指菜单里写到、被记下的那一个）
G. n. 盘子、待客（指一件事里人人都吃却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 待客（抽象总称，指人人都吃却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: washed the plate that no guest in the canteen would have noted
The plate, meaning the dish itself and not the bowl
the plate at the far table
the plate was the whole of the matter
the plate had become a line in a menu

answers.why: wash the plate 意为“洗这一个盘子”，1982 年那位厨子把食堂里没有一位客人肯记下的一个盘子做了一遍。
plate 意为“盘子；碟子”，指那个盘子本身而不是小小的碗，它经过了三个日子而在簿子上没有被记下。
plate 意为“盘子；碟子”，指食堂里每一个旁边的那一个，每一个旁边都有同一只小小的碗。
plate 意为“盘子；碟子”，指最远那张桌角的留给孩子们分着吃的那一份，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
plate 意为“盘子、待客”，指一件事里人人都吃却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这个待客就是那件事的全部。
plate 意为“待客”，指人人都吃却无人提起的那样东西而不是那个盘子，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
plate 意为“盘子；碟子”，指菜单里写到、被记下的那一个，到 1987 年这一个成了菜单里的一行。
plate 意为“盘子之事”，厨子九月写道，整件事的盘子之事是一处食堂和三个日子的记下。
plate 意为“盘子；碟子”，我记得的是菜单里记下过的那一个，1989 年开完了，至今仍被说成食堂里最安静的一个。
plate 为抽象总称，母亲 1991 年说，盘子是唯一会因为被好好记下而变得更好的盘子。
